introHtml: Tri blend fabric combines cotton, polyester, and rayon for a soft feel that holds up to frequent washing, making it an ideal choice for safety gear your team will actually want to wear. Unlike standard cotton or 100% polyester options, tri blend offers breathability with a vintage-style drape that prints and embroiders cleanly. Perfect for safety vests, hi-vis shirts, or uniform polos where comfort and visibility both matter.
heroAltText: Custom tri blend safety gear featuring a soft fabric blend with reflective stripes and company logo
